subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should ClawHub accept a public package changelog preview action that lets authorized package owners, publisher org members, moderators, and admins generate previews from prior release README content, including optional OpenAI use?
rationale: Code review can check the access gate, but a non-maintainer PR is expanding the package publishing trust boundary and using prior release storage as preview input.

options.title: Accept gated preview
options.body: Land the feature after conflict resolution with the current owner/publisher/staff access model and regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Require a stricter access policy, explicit privacy copy, or a spec note before allowing prior release README content into preview generation.

options.title: Keep changelogs manual
options.body: Close or pause the PR if package release changelog auto-preview is not desired for the publish flow.

recommendation.title: Accept gated preview
recommendation.body: Land the feature after conflict resolution with the current owner/publisher/staff access model and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest current-main history owner for the affected plugin publish/package backend surfaces and is requested for review.
